Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Prabhakar Singh, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Akshay Lal Pandit, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Bhabua P.S. Case No. 311 of 2018 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 423, 466, 467, 468, 469 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It is a case of cheating by impersonation.
This petitioner along with other accused persons got executed a sale deed of the land of complainant to someone else.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that petitioner is a bona-fide purchaser of the land in question.
The dispute involved in this case is with regard to sale and purchase of land, which is purely civil in nature.
Further submission is that title suit bearing Title Suit No. 269 of 2018 is Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.52688 of 2024(3) dt.13-09-2024 also pending between the parties.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

6. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned court below within a period of Nathuni Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99298804/
1 eight weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kaimur at Bhabua in connection with Bhabua P.S. Case No. 311 of 2018, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr. P.C. (Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) utkarsh/-
